firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently won a game starts; the rules also allow choosing randomly.
clarifications: That player takes the first-player token. In turn order, the second player takes one extra coin and the third and fourth take two extra coins each.
This is the original edition, separate from the second-edition answer.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 gives the recent-win criterion and random alternative. Its Starting Military cards, Citizen tokens, Empire cards and player-board setup match the original inventory BGG 147253, not the separately researched second edition.
